description: Frontend share controls + language-aware permalinks. Add a localized Share control (Web Share API with a copy-link fallback) to the SeriesDetailPage and the prediction panel; the shared URL is the permalink built by the shared buildSeriesPermalink and includes the current UI language. Make the SPA read ?lang= from the URL on load and set the i18n language accordingly so a shared JA link opens in Japanese. Surface the localized disclaimer in the share text. Add component unit tests and extend the Playwright e2e suite.
steps: Add a ShareButton component in frontend/src/components/ShareButton.tsx: props { season; seriesId; title; disclaimer }. It builds the permalink via the shared buildSeriesPermalink using window.location.origin and the current i18n lang. On click, if navigator.share is a function, call navigator.share({ title, text: `${title} - ${disclaimer}`, url }); otherwise fall back to navigator.clipboard.writeText(url) (and, if clipboard is also unavailable, select a hidden input / show the URL) and show a localized 'Link copied' confirmation. Guard all browser APIs so it is safe under jsdom. Localize the button label, the copied confirmation, and the aria-label (new MessageKeys in frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts for both ja and en, e.g. share.button, share.copied, share.ariaLabel).

Render ShareButton on SeriesDetailPage (frontend/src/pages/SeriesDetailPage.tsx) in the detail header, passing season, series.id, a localized title (teams + round), and the localized SHARE_DISCLAIMER from '@mlb/shared'. Also render it in the prediction panel (frontend/src/components/PredictionPanel.tsx) for a started/predictable series, passing the same permalink inputs so a user can share a prediction. The disclaimer text must be visible near the prediction output too (criterion 3) - add a small localized disclaimer line in the panel if not already present.

Make the SPA honor ?lang= on load. In frontend/src/i18n/index.ts (or a tiny helper read in I18nProvider), read the `lang` query param from window.location.search on first mount; if it is a valid Lang, use it as the initial language (taking precedence over the persisted value) and persist it. Keep the existing localStorage default/persist behavior otherwise. Add/extend a unit test (frontend/src/i18n/index.test.ts) asserting ?lang=en opens in English and ?lang=ja in Japanese, and an invalid value falls back to the stored/default language.

Add frontend/src/components/ShareButton.test.tsx covering: (a) navigator.share present -> clicking calls navigator.share with a url containing the seriesId and `lang=` of the active language and text containing the disclaimer; (b) navigator.share absent -> clicking calls clipboard.writeText with the permalink and shows the localized 'copied' confirmation; (c) the permalink reflects the active i18n language (render under I18nProvider initialLang='en' vs 'ja').

Extend the Playwright e2e suite. Add frontend/e2e/share.spec.ts: on a finished-series detail page the Share button is visible; stub navigator.share (and/or clipboard) before load, click Share, and assert the invoked/copied URL contains both `lang=` and the series id; separately load the app with `?lang=ja` and assert a known JA-only string renders (app opens in Japanese), and with `?lang=en` a known EN string renders. Reuse the existing e2e fixtures/mock API pattern (see frontend/e2e/fixtures.ts and detail.spec.ts). Keep prior specs green.

If index.html carries static default OG tags, optionally add generic default og:title/og:description/og:image meta tags to frontend/index.html for the SPA shell (non-per-series) and note that per-series tags come from the /share Lambda; update frontend/src/index-html.test.ts if it asserts head contents.

Run `PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run build && npm test`, then `npm run test:e2e -w frontend` (install chromium first if needed: `npx playwright install chromium`). Confirm the new specs pass and prior specs still pass.
Commit, e.g. `feat(issue-21): share button (Web Share + copy fallback), lang-aware permalinks, and e2e`.
acceptance_criteria: SeriesDetailPage and the prediction panel render a localized Share control that shares/copies a permalink containing the seriesId and the active language `lang=` (ShareButton.test.tsx passes, both Web Share present and absent paths).
Loading the app with ?lang=ja opens it in Japanese and ?lang=en in English; an invalid value falls back (i18n test passes).
The shared text / nearby UI includes the localized disclaimer (predictions are reference values, not betting advice).
frontend/e2e/share.spec.ts passes headless and all prior e2e specs still pass.
findings: Added ShareButton.tsx (Web Share -> clipboard -> manual-copy input fallback, all browser APIs feature-detected for jsdom safety) rendered in the SeriesDetailPage header and inside PredictionPanel's success result (with a visible localized disclaimer line near the prediction, criterion 3). New MessageKeys share.button/copied/ariaLabel/disclaimer added to both ja+en; the ja share.disclaimer matches SHARE_DISCLAIMER.ja. I18nProvider now reads ?lang= from window.location.search on first mount via new readLangFromQuery() helper, taking precedence over localStorage and persisting the chosen lang (initialLang prop still wins for tests). Renamed frontend/src/i18n/index.test.ts -> index.test.tsx (now renders JSX) and extended it with query-param cases. Added ShareButton.test.tsx (share-present, clipboard fallback, ja confirmation, lang reflects i18n, manual-copy degradation) and e2e share.spec.ts (stubs navigator.share/clipboard via addInitScript, asserts URL contains seriesId + lang=; ?lang=ja/en open the detail page in the right language). Did NOT modify index.html (step 6 optional; index-html.test.ts only guards the theme bootstrap, not OG tags; per-series OG tags come from the /share Lambda). Verified: npm run build, npm test (all workspaces), and npm run test:e2e -w frontend (52 e2e passed) all green.
